change type

  • CURIE: gmeow:changeType
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/changeType
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/languages

The kind(s) of linguistic change occurring — sound shift, borrowing, standardization, extinction, etc. NON-FUNCTIONAL: a single event may instantiate multiple change types from different analytical standpoints.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:LanguageChangeEvent -> gmeow:LanguageChangeType

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:changeType from gmeow:LanguageChangeEvent to gmeow:LanguageChangeType when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:LanguageChangeEvent, gmeow:LanguageChangeType
